An '''agent's belt''' was an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn by [[Imperial Agent|Imperial agents]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was [[Black (disambiguation)|black]] in color and had several metal plates attached to it which included [[Blue (disambiguation)|blue]] patterning as did the front belt buckle.
